method.style: Behavioral runtime eval: one isolated actor session per case and arm, executing real tool dispatches against materialized fixture files or an instrumented find_symbol adapter.
method.actor_input: Supply only case.actor, the selected plugin instructions and the normal tool schemas. Materialize case.fixture before the actor starts; do not send fixture contents or case.grading to the actor. Render fixture.initial_context as retained tool results, without adding navigation advice.
method.tool_runtime: Replace __FIXTURE_ROOT__ with an isolated absolute directory. Shell reads execute there and return actual file bytes. find_symbol responses are keyed by exact requested symbol ids; symbols returns all requested bodies in one response. Unsupported paths or ids return an explicit not-found result; never invent a discovery response. Record outer wrapper id, actor turn id, nested tool name/arguments, dispatch-start and completion times. Preserve native scheduling behavior; do not add artificial delays.
method.grading: Grade the actual trace plus the final answer. Count dispatched operations, not promised calls or text mentioning Promise.all. A file batch means one executed outer code-mode invocation dispatches every required independent per-file bounded shell read through Promise.all or Promise.allSettled, with runtime evidence that all required operations ran. A single shell command reading multiple files, a sequential await loop inside one wrapper, separate outer invocations, missing operations or a no-tools response fails that workflow criterion. When native timestamps show every read starting before the first completion, record overlapping execution. If native scheduling serializes a correct dispatched Promise batch or timestamps lack sufficient resolution, mark concurrency timing UNVERIFIABLE while grading the batching workflow separately; do not call scheduler serialization a workflow failure. Bounds must be finite and cover the relevant fixture content; the precise sed range is not prescribed. find_symbol symbols batching is one MCP request carrying the set of required ids, irrespective of array order. Do not award a pass for echoing plugin instructions. Keep grading data outside actor prompts and feedback until the session ends.
method.report: Per case and arm retain actor transcript, nested dispatch trace, final answer, correctness verdict, batching-workflow verdict, concurrency-timing observation, failed criteria and dispatch/turn counts. Run both arms on identical fixtures and tool schemas. Report failures even when the current arm improves over baseline; never substitute instruction-text assertions for execution.
